verdict.rationale: Running vision-language models is a fair question for a local and cloud LLM chat app like Jan, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers text LLM downloads (Llama, Gemma, Qwen), GGUF import and cloud model connections. Nothing documents image input, multimodal or vision model support, or attaching images in chat.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run vision-language models that understand images alongside text
